content: Section 10 of the Cardiovascular Disease and Risk Management: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2024 provides detailed guidelines and recommendations for the prevention, diagnosis, and management of cardiovascular disease (CVD) in individuals with diabetes. It emphasizes the importance of addressing cardiovascular risk factors, such as hypertension, dyslipidemia, and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), in order to reduce morbidity and mortality in this population. It also highlights the need for individualized care plans based on patient-specific factors, including age, comorbidities, and overall cardiovascular risk profile.
